text: Multiphase heterogeneous HRFs are owned by an exhaustive HrfByPhase algebra; the unscoped HrfByCell compatibility path is restricted to exactly one HRF term. Basis role and element identity are typed as BasisRole and BasisElementId. UnitMaximumAbsolute scales every nonzero column exactly, records its divisor, transports response-functional weights into fitted coordinates, and leaves ordinary coefficient hypotheses explicitly in realized coefficient coordinates.
